summary_1line: Arjuna and Karna exchange bitter taunts before a fierce duel in which Arjuna wounds and routs Karna, who briefly loses consciousness and flees.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna and Karna face each other on their chariots amid a storm of arrows, their bows drawn as soldiers watch in tense silence.
Arjuna’s blazing arrow pierces Karna’s armored chest, the impact staggering him in his chariot as the battlefield roars around them.
Karna, wounded and dizzy, turns his chariot northward in retreat while Arjuna stands firm with the Gandiva raised.
